name: Nicotine Gum
summary: Nicotine gum is an over-the-counter quit-smoking aid that gives you controlled doses of nicotine without the harmful chemicals in tobacco smoke, easing cravings and withdrawal.
description: Nicotine gum is an over-the-counter nicotine replacement therapy that helps people quit smoking by giving controlled doses of nicotine without the harmful chemicals found in tobacco smoke. Chewing the gum releases nicotine, which is absorbed through the lining of the mouth. It helps reduce cravings and withdrawal symptoms while you quit.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Nicotine gum is an over-the-counter nicotine replacement therapy designed to help people quit smoking by delivering controlled doses of nicotine without the harmful chemicals found in tobacco smoke. Chewing the gum releases nicotine, which is absorbed through the oral mucosa. It helps reduce cravings and withdrawal symptoms during smoking cessation efforts.
